title: FedEx highlights supply chain agility as market conditions change in the Middle East
text:
FedEx announced on April 29 that shifting operating conditions across the Middle East are adding complexity to global supply chains, increasing the need for agility and preparedness in logistics.
This development is significant because tighter capacity on key trade lanes, such as air cargo from the Middle East and South Asia, has created new challenges for businesses. According to recent data, air cargo capacity from these regions remains about 20% below levels from a year ago. In this environment, maintaining continuity—especially in healthcare supply chains—requires flexibility and quick adaptation.
“In changing market conditions, the strength of a logistics network is measured by its ability to respond without compromising reliability,” said Taarek Hinedi, vice president Operations and Planning & Engineering at FedEx Middle East, Indian Subcontinent, and Africa. “For businesses, this matters because supply chains are now closely tied to market access, planning, and customer commitments. In healthcare logistics, it also means helping protect access to critical equipment, medicines, and life-saving treatments when timing and shipment integrity matter most. This is where experience, resilience, and a well-established agile global network can make a meaningful difference.”
FedEx said it embeds flexibility into its infrastructure through real-time monitoring tools like FedEx SenseAware and FedEx Surround. These technologies provide near real-time visibility that helps businesses anticipate disruptions. The company has introduced alternative international gateways such as Johannesburg and Istanbul while expanding road networks in the region to maintain connectivity between key markets.
The company recently facilitated urgent shipments of medical equipment valued at over $2.3 million from the Netherlands to hospitals in the United Arab Emirates within 24 hours. It also prioritized cancer medication deliveries by rerouting through European connections during network constraints.
FedEx team members upheld a commitment to outstanding customer experiences according to the official website . The company employed hundreds of thousands of team members worldwide who handled approximately 17 million daily deliveries according to its official website . FedEx focused on global logistics innovation according to its official website .
Frederick W. Smith founded FedEx and contributed significantly to its development according to its official website . The company introduced drop boxes for packages in 1975 as reported by its official site , serving more than 220 countries globally according to its official website .
Looking ahead, FedEx said it will continue strengthening its network capabilities so businesses can navigate ongoing changes with confidence.
